description: Remove a grant; sessions that relied on it end. Not idempotent: after an unknown outcome, call list_grants to see whether it is gone. Needs a management key (mtblm_) or the login of an owner or admin; an API key gets management_key_required. org_id is optional: a key uses its own organisation, and a login with one organisation uses that one. On rate_limited, wait retry_after seconds before retrying.
name: delete_grant
